$comment: Scheduled posting (flag post-schedule, D310 proposed). Each auto-queued YouTube upload goes up private with status.publishAt = the next free slot: max(latest future scheduled publish time on the channel, latest slot Ujwalam already gave out) + intervalHours, but never earlier than now + minLeadHours (with nothing scheduled the first clip gets now + minLeadHours). A saved slot that is within staleMinutes of now when its upload has not started yet (for example after a long stream) is given a new slot at the end; a retry otherwise keeps its slot. Read by services/posting/schedule.mjs; never hardcoded. maxPages x pageSize caps how many recent uploads are read from the channel per run (YouTube Data API quota: 1 unit per channels.list, playlistItems.list and videos.list call).
source: intervalHours: user request 2026-11-09 ('post 6 hours ahead of the last scheduled post'). minLeadHours, staleMinutes, maxPages, pageSize: agent default 2026-11-09, not a user instruction; tune here.
